content.text: No minimum-commitment or take-or-pay language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment obligation on us: searches for "minimum", "commit", "purchase" and "renew" return nothing of that kind. Section 11 simply obliges us to pay the fees set out in the Fee Schedule for the licence and services actually taken, Section 2 charges additional fees only if we elect to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations, and Section 10 makes maintenance a renewable one-year term (not a multi-year committed spend). We also retain an unconditional right to terminate on ninety (90) days' notice under Section 17(b). This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered services only). The only usage limits on us are ordinary licence-scope restrictions in Section 3 (copying, sublicensing, reverse engineering), which are not volume commitments and are noted only for completeness.
